'''Marcum''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] of the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] noble [[House of Thul]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He had a holoconversation with [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Kendoh Thul]] and Count [[Ferrin]], when their talk was interrupted by the [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]].
